attributes.result: FOUR CONTRADICTIONS, each measured, with a proposed disposition. CONTRADICTION 1 -- THE ORDER'S NAMED ONE, AND THE LAW'S OWN FALSIFIER IS WORDED ON THE WRONG OBSERVABLE. claim.law.AL_the-addr16lo-surplus-copy-roster-...20260904.v1 (04:12Z) concludes 'the reachable remainder is ONE function -- ProcessCritterList' and its falsifier (2) reads 'if a declaration-order swap there is NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL, the polarity stops predicting and the reachable remainder is ZERO, not one'. attempt.CR_processcritterlist-...20260904.v1 (06:00Z, 1h48m later, `refutes` this law) measured three declaration orders. TWO of them were NOT neutral-identical -- both printed `REGRESSED vs best 29: real 29 -> 37 (insns T49/O50, multiset 1t)` -- so the falsifier AS LITERALLY WORDED was not discharged; what CR actually measured is 'in ALL THREE orders the count stayed T49/O50 and the surplus `addi r5,r4,0` copy survived unchanged'. The law's decisive observable is the COPY and the COUNT; it wrote its falsifier on the OBJECT DIGEST. A regressing swap is, under the literal wording, neither confirming nor falsifying -- a third state the falsifier does not admit. DISPOSITION: supersede with a v2 restating falsifier (2) as 'if no declaration order removes the surplus `addi r5,r4,0` or moves the count off T49/O50', and record the remainder as ZERO. CONTRADICTION 2 -- THE ROSTER NUMBERS ARE STALE ON THE DAY THEY WERE WRITTEN. That law states 'of the 45-function P roster, 40 are B, 5 are V (_AdsThread, ProcessCritterList, check_prefs_loaded, setup_vmu_entries and move_logic22)'. Run at HEAD, its own `asserted_by` tool prints `V 4 / B 39 / TOTAL 43 of 43 P-roster rows resolved`: move_logic22 is gone (closed by the decl-order swap the law itself cites, commit cdf25509e) and one B row has left too. `python tools/gdl/addrlo_home_general_census.py` reads `POPULATION P (n=39)` against the family's published P=40, with `POPULATION S (n=0)` holding. DISPOSITION: the same v2 carries the HEAD numbers and states that this family's rosters must be RUN, never quoted. CONTRADICTION 3 -- 'THE POPULATION IS EMPTY' IS FALSE AT HEAD, AND ITS OWN TOOL SAYS SO. claim.law.addrlo-inplace-lever-needs-a-paid-copy-and-its-population-is-empty.20260901.v1 concludes 'the lever population is EMPTY', 'L=9 reduces to L-PAID=0', 'NOT ONE FUNCTION IN THE IMAGE currently pays a copy for an in-place fold that the target avoids', 'there is no sweep to run today', and gives its positive control as L-PAID=1 naming ui/select::init_player_change. At HEAD its named reproduction tool prints `L=11 sites diverge in form; only 1 pay a copy for it` and `POPULATION L-PAID -- TRUE lever roster (in-place fold FORCES a copy) (n=1): game/enemy/critter ProcessCritterList gPlayers`. The population is not empty and the member is not the one the control named. DISPOSITION: supersede -- the law's MECHANISM (the cost test) is correct and is the family's best idea; only its emptiness conclusion is dead. Note the reconciliation this makes possible and no live law states: V and L-PAID intersect on exactly one row, and that row carries a typed denial saying the lever is inert on it. CONTRADICTION 4 -- A COUNTER-EXAMPLED DISCRIMINATOR IS STILL PUBLISHED AS SETTLED, AND ITS FALSIFIER CANNOT BE RUN BY ANYONE. claim.law.NC_pre-frame-addr16-lo-into-r0-owes-a-callee-saved-copy.20260903.v1 asserts a clean two-group split ('FOUR write it into r0 and every one of those owes the mr ... SEVEN write it into a NAMED volatile and none of them owes a copy'); claim.law.CR_...counter-example-and-the-census-floor-is-the-reason.20260904.v1 exhibits ProcessCritterList as a twelfth instance that writes a named volatile AND owes the copy, which is NC's own named falsifier discharged verbatim. NC carries no `superseded_by` and CR carries no `refutes`. Worse, NC's falsifier names its census as `NC_scratch/nc_prologue_census.py`, an untracked per-worktree path; CR flagged that a repo-rooted equivalent is 'a precondition for discharging this falsifier at all'. ABSENCE SCREEN, run rather than asserted: `Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Path tools -Filter '*prologue*'` returns nothing and `Get-ChildItem tools\gdl\composed_census -Filter 'nc_*'` returns nothing. The tool still does not exist, so NC's discriminator can be neither confirmed nor repaired image-wide. DISPOSITION: NC gets a v2 dropping the two-group discriminator to a hypothesis-about-the-floor and keeping the r0 half (which is unchallenged); the image-wide prologue census is a TOOL-LANE item (T25), because a falsifier rooted in an untracked path is exactly what proposal gate M refuses on new records and this one predates it.
